column1: # Which issues apply to which recipes.
# Tab separated: slug, include globs, exclude globs. Globs match recipe paths of the form
# <Checkpoint-Name>/<hardware>, expanded against the recipes that actually exist. Comma separates
# multiple patterns. A dash means none.
# Maintainers use this in both directions: every included recipe must carry the issue block, and a
# recipe carrying a block it is not listed for is a failure, which is how stale copies are caught
# when a recipe stops being affected.
# The exclude column matters as much as the include column. A mandatory paste that is wrong in a
# recipe is worse than a cross-reference: the single-GPU recipes have no NCCL process group, so the
